howto.name: Upload multiple PDFs
howto.text: Drag up to 50 PDF files. Up to 500 MB per file.

howto.name: Pick compression level
howto.text: Light (modest reduction, best quality), Recommended (balanced — default), Extreme (smallest files, some image-quality loss).

howto.name: Compress and download as ZIP
howto.text: Click Compress. Files are processed in parallel across 4 workers. Results are bundled into a ZIP with a savings summary.

faq.q: How many PDFs can I upload?
faq.a: Up to 50 files per batch, up to 500 MB per file.
Yes — the backend runs 4 worker processes simultaneously, so 4 files compress at once. Total time scales nearly linearly with file count divided by 4.

faq.q: What's the difference between Light, Recommended, and Extreme?
faq.a: Light shrinks structure only (5–30% reduction, no visible quality loss). Recommended (default) resamples images at 150 DPI (40–70% reduction). Extreme drops to 96 DPI and lower JPEG quality (60–90% reduction).
